caveats: Thresholds and climatology per grid cell and day of year: pool = SST values on dates within +/-5 calendar days of each baseline date (1992-2002), 121 dates per day of year; windows reach 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05; day 60 (29 Feb) has no pool of its own and was set to the mean of days 59 and 61 before smoothing; 90th percentile computed with numpy method='hazen' ignoring NaN; both arrays smoothed with a 31-day centred moving mean wrapping the 366-day year. MHWs: hot day = SST (K, as stored) >= smoothed threshold; per-cell MHW = run of >=5 consecutive hot days; MHWs separated by 1-2 non-hot days are joined (gap days included); no cell in this period had more than one such run, so no joins were triggered. Sea cells = 3308 of 3600 region cells finite on all target days; land/ice cells set to 0.
